text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria's opposition Front of Socialist Forces may decide to take part in June legislative elections.
- What are chances for independent candidates in legislative elections?
- U.S. government maintains stance of positive neutrality towards Algeria.
- Algeria's domestic political scene is becoming animated after recent speech by President Zeroual.
- Party leaders start unofficial election campaign. Realistic discussion of social issues is replacing old discourse.
